summary: Detroit area resident, software engineer with expertise in programming languages and compilers, strong interest in open-source software and software development practices, advocates for net neutrality and critiques corporate influence in technology, passionate about health and wellness, particularly the benefits of iodine and magnesium, engaged in discussions about economic policies and their impact on society, critical of current educational systems and their effectiveness, has a background in electric vehicles and renewable energy technologies, enjoys discussing complex scientific concepts, particularly in physics and mathematics, has a family structure that includes children, expresses concern about societal issues such as overpopulation and healthcare access.
